value_conclusion.observed_difference: With-skill outputs consistently use a claim/provenance/uncertainty table. Plain Codex also produced usable grounded drafts and recovered safely.
value_conclusion.commercial_implication: Keep the example a free demonstration; do not present it as differentiated paid value. Next offer needs buyer-specific source handling or a measured outcome beyond the capable baseline.
value_conclusion.generalization: Three selected pairs, one run per arm, unblinded lead judgments; no statistically general or causal quality result.

measurement_limits: Native input may include context again after the skill-read tool turn; processed tokens are not unique prompt tokens or cash.

No hard word limit in these cases; original parent-suite length/advice failures remain unchanged.
Missing-source recovery is advisory draft behavior, not evidence of application crash/interruption recovery or cold-use installation.
Observed tools comply with the requested boundary; this does not prove filesystem access revocation or universal enforcement.
